notes.title: Road 96 Second Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Hitchhikers![/h2]

[h5][i]It is the second anniversary of our beloved Road 96! We want to thank you all for your unwavering love and immense support for our project ❤️ We want you to know that we’re deeply grateful and committed to continue to pour our hearts into developing our games, we have no intention of slowing down.[/i][/h5]

[h3]Physical Book Announcement![/h3]

We have a fantastic surprise for you! Well, hold onto your hats because the interactive book "Road 96: About a Girl" will be [u][b]RELEASED SOON[/b][/u] in a beautifully crafted [b]physical edition[/b].

The narrative of the book follows Zoe's journey after the events of Road 96: Mile 0 and Road 96. Ever wondered what happened to Zoe after leaving White Sands? The book sheds light on her journey, family, and struggles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/75ab07d88d229805c0eecbab62105cf68a6e0cf0.png[/img]

But that is not all! Did you miss our beloved characters? You will get the chance to encounter them all – cool and a bit crazy Stan and Mitch, stunning Sonya, dinosaur fan Jarod, talented boy Alex, warm-hearted Fanny, Papa Bear and maybe… even Kaito!

The book will remain interactive, allowing you to make choices at the end of each chapter and decide how the story will develop, making it fun to reread and uncover more details about Zoe and Petria!. 

[quote=author] [h5]If you're craving the tangible delight of a physical copy, it will be available soon on our [u][b][url=https://road96.com/]brand-new Website here[/url][/b][/u][/h5][/quote]

[h5]For those who cannot wait for the physical release and eager to explore the digital version of the e-book, simply follow this link: [/h5]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322790/Road_96_Mile_0__About_a_Girl/

Picture decorating your shelf with this masterpiece, savoring the scent of freshly printed paper, and getting lost in its mesmerizing illustrations and captivating story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/286f52a23c8f07bb7b7ff622154e8833e794d438.png[/img]
[h3]New Website![/h3]

As you could notice, Road 96 had it is [u][b][url=https://road96.com/]own website road96.com[/url][/b][/u]! Here you can find all the cool stuff in the Road 96 franchise – from games and books to awesome merchandise! 

Check it out here! We think it looks cool :) What do you think? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/96fdbfea738e88c4a651ce119768b42c756e2af7.gif[/img]

[h5]We can't express enough how much your kind words and unwavering support mean to our team. Your support is truly inspiring and fueling us to keep our project moving forward! Stay tuned for more from our team. Rest assured, we are far from finished with the captivating universe of Road 96![/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/22a487119971271818535a8ad04c644cb998ad93.png[/img]

[h3]With endless gratitude, 
DigixArt Team[/h3]

notes.title: New Patch for Win 32
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, amazing community!

[/h2]
We just wanted to say a big thank you to all of you who shared your feedback on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/]Road 96: Mile 0[/url]. We're sorry to hear that some of you have been dealing with technical issues while playing the game.

We've been working hard to make things better! Today, we're excited to release a new patch for Win 32 version fixing multiple technical issues: 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to enter Zoe's Room before discussing with Kaito in Oasis Villas
[*] Fixed an issue affecting the shed’s lightbulb when tearing off the cables in Oasis Villas.
[*] Fixed an issue where Zoe’s voice clips would play instead of Kaito’s when using the seesaw in Oasis Villas.
[*] A save point was added when going from Oasis Villas to the final map in act II.
[*] Tweaked the tattoo minigame to prevent some issues affecting a small portion of players
[*] Fixed an issue where Colton could sometimes be heard repeating himself when pushing him on the swing.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player to progress during the walkie-talkie discussion in Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player if a ride replay was triggered during an after ride Hideout chapter
[*] Removed John floating in the Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue where John’s truck would sometimes appear floating in the air in the Hideout in act II.
[*] The location of the bouncing ball in the Hideout has been changed.
[*] Fixed a collider issue causing the player to fall through the map in Presidential Park
[*] The turnstile in the Presidential Square’s police station now blocks the player as intended.
[*] Fixed the issue where the music box in Presidential Square was erroneously referred to as a “pair of earrings” when playing the game in English.
[*] Several parts of the treasure hunt mini-game have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue affecting Stan & Mitch’s license plate texture
[*] Fixed an issue allowing Zoe to fly out of bounds in the ride “A taste of freedom”.
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player from progressing after failing a certain QTE in the ride  “A taste of freedom”.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Zoe to be misaligned during a laser section in the ride “Heist at the palace”
[*] Small changes to the credits
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the audio to echo when players used a headphone with certain audio compressed settings enabled.
[/list]
Rest assured, we are committed to further improving the game. If you come across any technical issues, please don't hesitate to contact our [url=https://playersupport.plaion.com/hc/en-us/categories/9479670683805-Road-96-Mile-0?utm_source=linktree&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=support][u][b]technical support team[/b][/u][/url]. We will do our utmost to assist you promptly.

Thank you all for your support and patience. We're grateful to have such an awesome community!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone,[/h2]

We want to thank all of you who left your feedback about Road 96: Mile 0. We're sorry to hear that some of you have experienced technical difficulties while playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/cd0325493f6bb07a851b22246367a2cd60b95627.jpg[/img]

Our team is currently working hard to improve the game and gather all the valuable feedback that we've received. As part of our ongoing efforts, we are excited to release our first patch today, which aims to address the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing players from jumping during rides when the ingame FPS was higher than ~275. The game is now limited to 240fps. Players can still override that value by activating Vsync and using a screen that has a refresh rate higher than 240hz but we do not recommend players using it during rides as it might trigger the bug again.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to enter Zoe's Room before discussing with Kaito in Oasis Villas
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player to progress during the talkie walkie discussion in Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player if a ride replay was triggered during an after ride hideout chapter
[*] Fixed a collider issue causing the player to fall through the map in Presidential Park 
[*] Removed John floating in the Hideout
[*] Added a game version canvas on the main menu
[/list]
[h4]E-book "Road 96: About A Girl" patch note:[/h4]

[list]
[*] Added epub versions for both English and French versions of the book
[*] Fixed Some localization issues
[*] Fixed some hyperlink issues preventing player from progressing
[/list]
We will continue doing our best to make the game better. If you encounter any technical issues, please do not hesitate to reach out to our technical support team, and we'll do our best to assist you.

notes.title: Gameplay Insights
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We see that you are intrigued by the main gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/]Road 96: Mile 0[/url]. So, we will be happy to shed some light on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/69352e054e5fe7ac93fb6687ce2599cb34969a11.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Gameplay[/h3]
We know that many of you are worried that the Road 96 gameplay that you loved so much will be different in the prequel – Road 96: Mile 0. We have relieving news for you, Road 96: Mile 0 is still a [b]narrative adventure[/b] and the main gameplay is very similar to the one in Road 96. 

You will be able to discover the locations of White Sands with a first-person view, enjoy minigames, have dialogues and make choices that will determine the final ending in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/aefb260566bf7c814317d696a43218f5b14621ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
A new feature in the gameplay is “Musical rides” – the skating journey that will allow you to better understand and feel the story of the characters and the world of Petria through a combination of visuals and music. It is not the main gameplay part, but it is still an important part of immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/89a63907bd539458e2d7cf54968d4cfc7031ba90.gif[/img]

The music is a vital part for all of us working on the game, so we do our best to choose the most fitting and touching sounds for you to truly experience and enjoy the game as much as possible! We hope that you will like the combination of the old and new mechanics ❤️
